commit.message:
8393268: AArch64: Implement zStorePNull for AArch64

There is an opportunity to reduce the number of instructions emitted when
nulls are being stored on AArch64. Currently the sequence of instructions
for a store of null is:

  mov x17, xzr
  mov x14, #<colour>
  orr x14, x14, x17, lsl #16
  str x14, x12, #48

By implementing zStorePNull we can reduce this to:

  mov x14, #<colour>
  str x14, x12, #48

Overall the effect is minor, if there are no uses for a null reference,
then the "mov x17, xzr" won't be emitted an a register is saved.
Otherwise, code becomes compact by the elimination of the "orr"
instruction.

Also, the opportunity was taken to replace the "movq" mnemonics in the
match rules to match more closely the instructions emitted for aarch64.
